title: SandboxAQ Open Sources Switch: Bring Any AI Agent Into Any Team Chat
summary: SandboxAQ Open Sources Switch: Bring Any AI Agent Into Any Team Chat PR Newswire
body: SandboxAQ Open Sources Switch: Bring Any AI Agent Into Any Team Chat PR Newswire
summaryZh: SandboxAQ宣布开源名为Switch的新工具，旨在帮助开发者将任意定制的AI智能体无缝接入各种团队聊天与协作平台中，简化了智能体在日常办公通信场景中的落地与交互流程。原始信息显示：SandboxAQ Open Sources Switch: Bring Any AI Agent Into Any Team Chat PR Newswire。该消息由PR Newswire发布，主题为“SandboxAQ Open Sources Switch: Bring Any AI Agent Into Any Team Chat”。其重要性主要体现在：SandboxAQ开源了名为Switch的工具，允许将任意AI智能体集成至团队聊天工具中。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
